PROTOTYPE - beer glass silhouettes (issue #6)

The shapes are the hand-modelled paths, dropped in as supplied. The arrows flip between four symmetry corrections of each - as supplied, mirror the left profile, mirror the right, or average the two - applied by rule, with the head refitted to whatever rim results. The chips switch beer Colour, theme background, and the stem tint.
